header.demo_notice: CofiBlocks Traceability · Ethiopia pilot on Stellar Testnet.

footer.description: Traceability for every coffee batch, from the farm to export. Verified on Stellar.

home.meta_description: Follow every coffee batch from the farm to export, verified on Stellar.
home.eyebrow: ETHIOPIA PILOT · JIMMA ZONE, GOMMA WOREDA
home.hero_title: Every coffee batch, from the farm to export.
home.hero_subtitle: Farmers, cooperatives and the union record each step of the coffee. Every change is signed and verifiable on Stellar, without exposing personal data.
home.step_farmers_text: They register with the ID their cooperative gave them, add their plots and follow their coffee from the bot.
home.step_coop_text: Collection centers register each delivery; processing and warehouse staff update each stage of the batch.
home.step_union_text: Records quality, sales and documents, and generates anonymized EUDR reports.
home.verified_text: Only pseudonymous IDs and fingerprints (hashes) of each record go on chain. Names, phones and GPS points stay private.
home.no_role_text: An administrator will assign your role in the pilot. Once you have it, your tasks will appear here.
home.admin_users_text: Assign each person their role and cooperative. The role is written to the contract.
home.admin_farmers_text: Upload the farmer list of each cooperative and follow their registration in the bot.
